description_expanded: SummaryExperience laid-back luxury at this Blue Mountain Beach vacation rental, perfectly positioned for family fun and coastal relaxation. With 4 bedrooms across 3 spacious levels, this home features a screened-in balcony, grill, and 2 living areas. Walk or bike to the beach, explore nearby trails, and enjoy easy access to dining and shopping—all from a thoughtfully designed home base with a fully stocked kitchen.SpaceLocation perks: Blue Mountain Beach Access (0.4 miles), Point Washington State Forest Trails (0.6 miles), Gulf Place Town Center (2.1 miles), Grayton Beach State Park (3.2 miles), Seaside (4.3 miles) Interior: — Kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, blender, cooking utensils, tableware) — 5 Smart TVs with cable — Central heat and A/C — In-unit washer and dryer — Free WiFi — 2 living rooms — 2,872 sq. ft. Exterior: — Gas grill — Private pool — Screened balcony with seating — Outdoor dining area (seats 12) — Bike rack — Outdoor shower — On-site parking for 2 cars (driveway only) First Floor: Kitchen, dining area, living room, half bathroom Second floor: 2 bedrooms (king beds), 2 en-suite bathrooms, Third Floor: 1 bunk room ( 4 full-sized beds (2 sets of bunk beds)., 1 full bathroom, 1 Living Room, 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 en-suite bathroom, Local rental license number: NeighborhoodThis home is nestled in the laid-back community of Blue Mountain Beach, a beloved 30A locale known for its relaxed vibe and natural beauty. Guests can walk to the beach, or explore nearby trails in Point Washington State Forest. Local shops, cafes, and bike rentals are within a quick drive, and nearby towns like Grayton Beach and Seaside offer vibrant dining and arts scenes.TransitA car is recommended for broader area access. The beach, trailheads, and restaurants are all within a mile or two. There is no public transit nearby. AccessGuests have full access to the home, including both living rooms, grill, balconies, and in-unit laundry. Parking is available for 2 cars in the driveway. This home has a pack and play for guest use.NotesPlease keep in mind that if you plan to swim, you are responsible for verifying local beach conditions and flag warnings. Two stair steps are required to access the entry. Interior spans 3 levels. House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted.Read Less
